## Hello!  

I am a academic researcher in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, 
Machine Learning, Computation Linguistics, and Digital Humanities. I am 
passionate about science, arts, computers and education. I reall like to build 
mathematical models of various phenomena (especially in humain and 
social science), to implement numerical simulations, and to create data 
visualizations. 

With this website, I want to share some of my production. You will find 
teaching material, data visualizations, simulations and algorithms. 

I hope you will enjoy them!

:::

```{python}

#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
import textwrap

# Read data
try:
    with open('assets/cv.yaml', 'r') as f:
        data = yaml.safe_load(f)
except FileNotFoundError:
    data = {}

# 2. Fonction corrigée avec 'dedent'
def print_section(section_data):
    if not section_data:
        return
        
    for entry in section_data:
        # On définit le HTML
        raw_html = f"""
        <div class="cv-entry">
            <div class="cv-year">{entry['year']}</div>
            <div class="cv-details">
                <div class="cv-title">{entry['title']}</div>
                <div class="cv-institution">{entry['institution']}</div>
                <div class="cv-desc">{entry['description']}</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        """
        
        # MAGIC FIX : textwrap.dedent enlève l'indentation de Python
        # .strip() enlève les sauts de ligne inutiles au début/fin
        print(textwrap.dedent(raw_html).strip())
        print("\n") # Un saut de ligne Markdown pour séparer les blocs

# 3. Affichage des sections
if 'education' in data:
    print("## Education\n")
    print_section(data['education'])

if 'experience' in data:
    print("## Experience\n")
    print_section(data['experience'])
```
